title: 德基水庫大壩~Deji Dam
focus: 薄拱壩與梯級水力發電相依~Thin arch dams and cascading hydropower dependencies
summary: 德基課程把高拱壩、岩盤差異位移與大甲溪梯級發電放在共同的能量與量測架構中。跨流域水量、密度底流、管壁環向應力與水錘傳播各有不同邊界，不能只靠一個水頭數字判斷。最後以停機水量帳和儀器取樣問題檢查發電估算是否保持物理一致。~The Deji course connects a high arch dam, differential rock movement and cascading generation through energy and measurement. Diversion water balance, density underflows, pipe hoop stress and water-hammer travel each require distinct boundaries rather than a single head value. Outage accounting and instrument sampling then test whether an energy estimate remains physically consistent.
history: 台電歷史檔案記載一九七三年封堵蓄水，而水利署工程介紹列出一九七四年完成；兩個日期代表不同施工里程碑，不能互相取代。公開壩高為一百八十公尺，形式為雙曲率薄拱壩。教材沿大甲溪梯級背景討論能量守恆，沒有宣稱各級實際水頭與效率等於算例。美國一九九四年拱壩資料只作歷史方法索引，與曾文土石壩的並列用於比較承載方式及調蓄時間尺度。~Taipower records closure and initial impoundment in 1973, while the WRA profile gives completion in 1974. These are distinct milestones and should not replace one another. The public height is 180 m and the form is a thin double-curvature arch. Teaching follows the Dajia cascade context without asserting that actual stage heads or efficiencies equal the examples. The 1994 American arch reference is a historical method index; comparison with Tsengwen concerns load paths and storage time scales.
example: 假想兩級發電共用每秒十五立方公尺流量，淨水頭為二百及一百二十公尺、效率為零點九及零點八八，總功率由各級功率相加得四十二點零二六兆瓦。第二級效率下降到零點八時總量成四十點六一三四兆瓦，不能把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭。另一個假想鋼管半徑一點二公尺、壁厚零點零二公尺、內壓二兆帕，薄壁環向應力為一百二十兆帕；此式屬受拉管壁，不是受壓拱壩的設計應力。 核驗：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=15 m3/s; H1=200 m; H2=120 m; eta1=0.9; eta2=0.88; P=rho g Q(H1 eta1+H2 eta2)/1e6=42.02604 MW。分別畫每級進出口能量線，檢查中間尾水是否也是下一級上游基準。以各級電表與同時段流量比對，將中間蓄水變化另外入帳，再核對總電能沒有超過共同水流的可用位能。~Assume two generating stages carry the same 15 m3/s, with net heads 200 and 120 m and efficiencies 0.9 and 0.88. Adding stage powers gives 42.026 MW. If the second efficiency falls to 0.8, the total becomes 40.6134 MW; adding the two discharges and multiplying by combined head would double count water. A separate hypothetical steel pipe with radius 1.2 m, thickness 0.02 m and pressure 2 MPa has thin-wall hoop tension of 120 MPa. This pipe equation describes tension and is not an arch-dam compressive stress calculation. Verification: Draw inlet and outlet energy lines for each stage and check how intermediate tailwater connects to the next inlet. Compare stage electrical meters with synchronized flow, account separately for intermediate storage and verify that total energy stays below the water's available potential.

units.anchor: 梯級發電的能量相加~Energy addition across a cascade
units.title: 梯級發電的能量相加~Energy addition across a cascade
units.mechanism: 大甲溪梯級背景讓同一股水在不同高程依序釋放位能，每級只能利用其邊界內的淨水頭。功率應逐級計算再相加，不能把同一股串聯流量先相加又乘總落差。若中間有旁通、蓄水或取水，各級流量也未必相同，能量帳必須跟著水量控制體分段，並保留尾水與上游基準高程。~In a cascade, the same water releases potential energy at successive elevations, with each stage using only the net head within its boundary. Stage powers are calculated separately and added; adding the same serial flow first and multiplying by combined head double counts water. Bypass, storage and withdrawals can also make stage flows differ, requiring separate water accounts and explicit upstream and tailwater elevation references.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=15 m3/s; H1=200 m; H2=120 m; eta1=0.9; eta2=0.88; P=rho g Q(H1 eta1+H2 eta2)/1e6=42.02604 MW。適用邊界：兩級相同穩定流量且水頭為各級淨值，未使用德基實際機組參數。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=15 m3/s; H1=200 m; H2=120 m; eta1=0.9; eta2=0.88; P=rho g Q(H1 eta1+H2 eta2)/1e6=42.02604 MW. Applicable boundary: Two stages share constant flow and stage-specific net heads; no actual Deji machine parameters are used.
units.verify: 分別畫每級進出口能量線，檢查中間尾水是否也是下一級上游基準。以各級電表與同時段流量比對，將中間蓄水變化另外入帳，再核對總電能沒有超過共同水流的可用位能。~Draw inlet and outlet energy lines for each stage and check how intermediate tailwater connects to the next inlet. Compare stage electrical meters with synchronized flow, account separately for intermediate storage and verify that total energy stays below the water's available potential.
units.failure: 把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭會重複計入同一水體；若中間水庫正在蓄水卻仍假設流量立即一致，則會錯配發電時間，讓逐時能量帳失去守恆。~Adding serial discharges and multiplying by combined head counts the same water twice. Assuming immediate equal flow while an intermediate reservoir is storing water also shifts generation to the wrong time and breaks hourly accounting.
units.misconception: 串聯兩級流量應先相加再乘上總水頭~Serial stage discharges should be added before multiplying by total head
units.practice: 將第二級效率降至零點八，重算總功率與差額，再設中間暫存使第二級流量少三立方公尺每秒，分開求能量與蓄量變化而不混算。~Lower second-stage efficiency to zero point eight and recalculate total power. Then reduce its flow by three cubic metres per second through intermediate storage, calculating energy and storage changes in separate accounts.

units.anchor: 高壩底壓與水推力~Base pressure and water resultant
units.title: 高壩底壓與水推力~Base pressure and water resultant
units.mechanism: 德基高拱壩背景可用來區分局部壓力與整體水推力：底部靜水壓隨水深一次增加，但固定寬度投影上的合力隨深度平方增加。壓力的單位是力除面積，而合力才可進入整體受力平衡。水深應由自由水面量到計算點，不能直接把壩高當成每一時刻的有效水深，也不能忽略尾水反壓。~A high arch dam illustrates the difference between local pressure and integrated water force. Bottom hydrostatic pressure increases linearly with depth, while force on a fixed-width projection grows with depth squared. Pressure is force per area, whereas the resultant enters overall equilibrium. Depth is measured from the free surface to the point, not automatically equated with structural height, and downstream counterpressure must be considered when relevant.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa。適用邊界：靜止淡水的表壓，水深為假想值而非公開壩高或當前水位。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa. Applicable boundary: Gauge pressure in still fresh water, with hypothetical depth rather than dam height or current reservoir level.
units.verify: 用壓力三角形區分底壓與平均壓，再選一個投影寬度求合力以確認單位不同。核對壓力感測器是絕對壓還是表壓，並將安裝高程與水面高程分開記錄，避免基準錯置。~Use a pressure triangle to separate bottom and mean pressures, then select a projected width to obtain force and check units. Identify absolute versus gauge pressure sensors and record installation and water-surface elevations separately to prevent datum errors.
units.failure: 直接拿一百八十公尺壩高代入每次水壓計算會忽略實際水位；把兆帕數字當作兆牛頓則漏掉面積，讓看似相近的數字實際代表完全不同的物理量。~Substituting structural height for every pressure calculation ignores changing water level. Treating a megapascal value as meganewtons omits area and confuses quantities that may look numerically similar but have different physical meanings.
units.misconception: 壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度~Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level
units.practice: 把假想水深降至一百二十公尺，分別求底壓倍率與同寬合力倍率，再說明為何不能以壓力變化百分比直接代表整體水推力變化。~Reduce hypothetical depth to one hundred twenty metres, calculate bottom-pressure and fixed-width force ratios, and explain why the percentage pressure change cannot directly represent the change in total water thrust.

units.anchor: 兩岸差異位移的應變尺度~Differential abutment movement scale
units.title: 兩岸差異位移的應變尺度~Differential abutment movement scale
units.mechanism: 拱壩兩岸共同平移與兩岸相對位移有不同結構意義，後者才會改變跨距或扭曲形狀。以相對位移除基準長度可得到平均幾何應變，便於比較監測量級；這不是局部混凝土應變，也沒有包含支承轉角。儀器的共同基準若一起移動，可能掩蓋絕對運動卻仍保留部分相對量。~Common translation of both abutments differs from relative movement, which can change span or distort the arch. Relative displacement divided by reference length gives an average geometric strain useful for comparing measurement scales, not local concrete strain and not support rotation. Movement of a shared instrument reference may hide absolute motion while leaving some relative measurements intact, so reference geometry belongs in the interpretation.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：uR=5 mm; uL=1 mm; L=200 m; eps=(uR-uL)/1000/L=0.00002。適用邊界：兩位移為沿原跨距連線方向的軸向投影，採小變形及同一穩定基準，只求跨距平均正應變。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: uR=5 mm; uL=1 mm; L=200 m; eps=(uR-uL)/1000/L=0.00002. Applicable boundary: Both movements are axial projections along the original span line, using small deformation and one stable datum; only span-average normal strain is calculated.
units.verify: 先將左右岸位移投影到原跨距連線軸線並確認小變形假設，再扣除共同平移量，確認毫米與公尺已轉換。以外部穩定測點閉合測量網，另記旋轉與垂直位移，避免一個水平差值被誤認為完整岩盤變形。~Project both movements onto the original span axis and verify the small-deformation assumption, remove common translation and convert millimetres to metres. Close the survey network against external stable points while separately recording rotation and vertical motion, so one horizontal difference is not treated as complete rock deformation.
units.failure: 把左右岸位移絕對值相加而不看方向，可能把共同平移誤認為跨距改變；若基準點位於同一移動岩塊上，則可能得到很小差值而漏掉整體位移。~Adding absolute movement magnitudes without direction can turn common translation into apparent span change. A reference on the same moving rock block may instead produce a small difference that misses larger absolute movement.
units.misconception: 兩岸同向等量平移必然造成跨距增加~Equal translation of both abutments in one direction necessarily increases span
units.practice: 將左右岸都額外平移三毫米，重算相對應變並比較絕對位移，然後增加一個支承轉角，說明為何單一跨距應變無法描述新的變形模式。~Add three millimetres of common translation to both sides and compare relative strain with absolute movement. Then introduce support rotation and explain why one span-average strain cannot describe the added deformation mode.

units.anchor: 濃密入流的底流尺度~Density underflow velocity scale
units.title: 濃密入流的底流尺度~Density underflow velocity scale
units.mechanism: 含砂較多的入流水可能比庫水密度大，沿底部向前推進形成密度流。以密度差定義約化重力，再與流層厚度組合可估算浮力控制的速度尺度。這個尺度不是底流實際速度，因為坡度、摩擦、混合與顆粒沉降都會改變流體密度及厚度，沿途不一定維持同一狀態。~Sediment-rich inflow can be denser than reservoir water and propagate along the bottom as a density current. Reduced gravity combined with current thickness provides a buoyancy velocity scale. It is not the actual underflow speed, because slope, friction, entrainment and particle settling alter density and thickness as the current advances, so conditions need not remain constant along the irregular reservoir floor.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：g=9.81 m/s2; drho=4 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; h=3 m; U=sqrt(g drho h/rho)=0.34310 m/s。適用邊界：小密度差的特徵速度，未選經驗福祿係數或推定真實底流到達時間。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: g=9.81 m/s2; drho=4 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; h=3 m; U=sqrt(g drho h/rho)=0.34310 m/s. Applicable boundary: A small-density-contrast velocity scale without an empirical Froude multiplier or a real arrival-time prediction.
units.verify: 同時量測入口與庫內不同深度的密度或含砂剖面，將溫度造成的密度差也分開。以多個測站到達時間估算傳播，對照流層厚度變化，檢查沿途混合是否讓原先密度差逐漸減弱。~Measure density or sediment profiles at the inlet and several reservoir depths while separating temperature contributions. Estimate propagation from arrival times at multiple stations and compare changing current thickness to determine whether entrainment weakens the original density contrast.
units.failure: 把入口密度差維持到整個水庫會忽略摻混與沉降；若直接用特徵速度除距離宣告準確到達時間，則把未包含的地形與阻力誤當不存在，造成錯誤預報信心。~Holding inlet density contrast constant throughout the reservoir neglects entrainment and settling. Turning a velocity scale into a precise arrival forecast also treats omitted topography and resistance as absent rather than unresolved.
units.misconception: 浮力速度尺度就是可直接預報的真實底流速度~The buoyancy velocity scale directly predicts the actual underflow speed
units.practice: 把流層厚度加倍而密度差減半，重算速度尺度並解釋為何數值可能不變，但兩個流場的混合、沉降與幾何條件仍然不同。~Double thickness while halving density contrast, recalculate the velocity scale and explain why its value may stay unchanged even though mixing, settling and geometric conditions differ between the two currents.

units.anchor: 越域引水的獨立水量帳~Separate diversion water accounting
units.title: 越域引水的獨立水量帳~Separate diversion water accounting
units.mechanism: 跨流域引水增加的是實際通過邊界的水，而非來源集水區全部降雨。德基背景的假想日水量帳把本地入流、引入流、機組用水與其他損失分開，避免把同一水量在來源及目的地重複計入。若隧道或中間池有暫存，兩端同時刻流量也可能不一致，需在更小控制體補上蓄量項。~Interbasin diversion adds water that actually crosses a boundary, not all rainfall over the source catchment. A daily account separates local inflow, imported flow, generation release and other losses to avoid counting one transfer twice. Storage in a tunnel or intermediate pool can make simultaneous endpoint flows differ, requiring an additional storage term in the smaller control volume rather than an unexplained balance error.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：VinLocal=900000 m3/day; Vdiv=250000 m3/day; Vout=1000000 m3/day; Vloss=30000 m3/day; dV=120000 m3/day。適用邊界：同一日邊界水量、損失已合併，未推定現行可引水量或水權。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: VinLocal=900000 m3/day; Vdiv=250000 m3/day; Vout=1000000 m3/day; Vloss=30000 m3/day; dV=120000 m3/day. Applicable boundary: Boundary volumes cover the same day with combined losses, without asserting current diversion entitlement or available supply.
units.verify: 將引水兩端資料依旅行時間對齊，核對水表累積值的起迄時刻，並把中間暫存單獨列出。對來源河川保留未引走流量，目的水庫只入帳實際收到的水，避免用設計流量代替量測。~Align diversion endpoint records for travel time, check cumulative-meter interval boundaries and account for intermediate storage. Retain undiverted flow in the source-river balance and credit the destination only with water received, not nominal design discharge.
units.failure: 來源流量、引水量與目的地入流同時相加會把轉送水重複計算；用設計輸水能力乘整日時間也可能高估實際供水，因為水源不足或停機會改變可送水量。~Adding source flow, diversion flow and destination inflow together duplicates transferred water. Multiplying design capacity by a whole day can overstate delivery when source scarcity or outages limit the quantity actually conveyed.
units.misconception: 跨流域水量可在來源與目的地總帳各算一次供水~Transferred water may count as new system supply at both source and destination
units.practice: 把引入水量減半，重新求日蓄量變化，再列出源頭及目的地兩本水量帳，證明對整個系統而言內部轉水應相互抵銷而不是創造新水。~Halve imported water and recalculate daily storage change. Write separate source and destination accounts and show that an internal transfer cancels in the combined system instead of creating additional water.

units.anchor: 局部低壓與汽化裕度~Local pressure and cavitation index
units.title: 局部低壓與汽化裕度~Local pressure and cavitation index
units.mechanism: 高速出流區的壓力若接近該水溫的蒸氣壓，可能產生汽化空穴，後續在高壓區潰滅造成侵蝕。氣蝕指數把絕對壓力超過蒸氣壓的差額除以動壓，提供相對尺度；各種幾何具有不同臨界條件，指數本身不能直接宣告安全，更不能把表壓與絕對蒸氣壓混用。~If local pressure approaches vapor pressure at the water temperature, cavities can form and later collapse in a higher-pressure region. A cavitation index divides the absolute-pressure margin above vapor pressure by dynamic pressure. It provides a relative scale, not a universal safe threshold, because critical behavior depends on geometry. Gauge pressure must not be mixed with absolute vapor pressure in the numerator.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：pabs=80000 Pa; pv=2500 Pa; rho=1000 kg/m3; v=18 m/s; sigma=(pabs-pv)/(0.5 rho v2)=0.478395。適用邊界：局部絕對壓力與指定蒸氣壓的假想狀態，不給定設備氣蝕臨界值。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: pabs=80000 Pa; pv=2500 Pa; rho=1000 kg/m3; v=18 m/s; sigma=(pabs-pv)/(0.5 rho v2)=0.478395. Applicable boundary: A hypothetical local absolute pressure and specified vapor pressure, without assigning an equipment cavitation threshold.
units.verify: 核對壓力儀表是否已加大氣壓，並記錄水溫以選對蒸氣壓。以局部速度而非管道平均值估算動壓，對照表面形狀與脈動資料，將氣蝕、磨蝕及化學侵蝕的證據分開檢查。~Confirm whether atmospheric pressure has been included and record water temperature for vapor pressure. Use local rather than blindly averaged velocity, compare geometry and pressure fluctuations, and distinguish evidence of cavitation from abrasion and chemical deterioration.
units.failure: 把表壓代替絕對壓力會嚴重改變裕度；即使平均指數相同，表面突起引起的局部加速與壓力脈動仍可能不同，因此不能用單一平均數排除局部氣蝕。~Substituting gauge for absolute pressure substantially changes the margin. Equal average indices can still accompany different local accelerations and pressure fluctuations around surface irregularities, so one mean value cannot exclude local cavitation.
units.misconception: 表壓可以直接減去絕對蒸氣壓來算氣蝕指數~Gauge pressure can directly subtract absolute vapor pressure in a cavitation index
units.practice: 保持局部壓力不變，把速度提高百分之十，重算指數並說明平方速度的影響，再列出真實流場中壓力也可能同步改變的原因。~Hold local pressure fixed, increase velocity ten percent and recalculate the index. Explain the squared-velocity effect and identify reasons why pressure itself may change simultaneously in a real flow field.

units.anchor: 鋼管環向拉應力~Steel pipe hoop tension
units.title: 鋼管環向拉應力~Steel pipe hoop tension
units.mechanism: 高水頭輸水鋼管承受內壓而產生環向拉力，與拱壩把外水壓轉為壓縮的受力方向不同。薄壁圓管可由切開半圓截面的平衡推得壓力乘半徑除壁厚的平均環向應力。壁厚相對半徑必須小，且此式不包含焊縫缺陷、腐蝕減薄、支承彎曲或壓力循環疲勞。~Internal pressure creates hoop tension in a steel water conduit, unlike the compression associated with external loading on an arch. Cutting a thin circular pipe into halves gives mean hoop stress as pressure times radius divided by wall thickness. Thickness must be small relative to radius, and the relation excludes weld defects, corrosion loss, support bending and fatigue caused by repeated pressure cycles.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa。適用邊界：薄壁圓管膜拉應力，厚半徑比為零點零一六七，不含軸力與局部缺陷。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa. Applicable boundary: Thin circular pipe membrane tension with thickness-radius ratio about 0.0167, excluding axial force and local defects.
units.verify: 用半圓管兩側拉力平衡投影水壓獨立推導，再以實測最小壁厚而非名目厚度比較。檢查量測位置、焊縫與支承附近是否需局部分析，並把壓力最高值與疲勞循環範圍分開。~Independently derive the relation from pressure on a half-pipe projection balanced by two tensile sections. Compare using measured minimum rather than nominal thickness, identify weld and support regions needing local analysis, and separate peak pressure from fatigue-cycle range.
units.failure: 使用名目厚度而忽略局部腐蝕會低估應力；把這個受拉管壁公式解讀成拱壩受壓驗證，雖形式相似卻混淆不同邊界與失效機制，不能互相替代。~Ignoring local corrosion while using nominal thickness understates stress. Applying this tensile pipe calculation as verification of a compressed dam arch confuses different boundaries and failure mechanisms despite the similar algebraic form.
units.misconception: 受拉薄壁管公式可直接證明受壓拱壩安全~A tensile thin-pipe equation directly proves the safety of a compressed arch dam
units.practice: 把有效壁厚降到十六毫米，重算環向應力並求增加百分比，再討論局部點蝕為何不能只用平均厚度減少量代表其應力集中。~Reduce effective thickness to sixteen millimetres, recalculate hoop stress and percentage increase, then explain why localized pitting cannot be represented solely by a uniform reduction in average wall thickness.

units.anchor: 壓力波往返時間~Pressure wave round trip time
units.title: 壓力波往返時間~Pressure wave round trip time
units.mechanism: 瞬變分析先要知道壓力訊息在水路中的傳播尺度，往返時間由兩倍管長除波速得到。它不是水粒子通過管線所需時間，也不是機組旋轉週期。把假想流量變化時間與往返時間比較，可判斷反射是否會在變化過程中返回，但多分支、調壓室及氣穴會使單管圖像需要擴充。~Transient interpretation starts with the time for a pressure signal to travel through the waterway and return, equal to twice length divided by wave speed. This is neither water-particle travel time nor machine rotation period. Comparing a hypothetical flow-change duration with this scale reveals whether reflections return during the change, while branches, surge chambers and cavities require more than the single-pipe picture.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L=1200 m; a=800 m/s; tr=2L/a=3 s。適用邊界：單一均勻管段且波速固定，只計傳播時間而非瞬變壓力。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L=1200 m; a=800 m/s; tr=2L/a=3 s. Applicable boundary: A single uniform pipe segment with constant wave speed; propagation time only, not transient pressure.
units.verify: 從兩支壓力感測器波峰的時間差估算波速，確認取樣時鐘同步並保留量測距離。再辨識反射峰而非把每個局部脈動都視為往返訊號，對多支管路應畫出各自傳播路徑。~Estimate wave speed from peak arrival differences at two synchronized pressure sensors with a known separation. Distinguish reflected peaks from unrelated local fluctuations, and draw separate propagation paths where multiple branches prevent one round-trip time from describing the network.
units.failure: 用平均流速代替波速會把秒級訊息傳播誤算成很長的旅行時間；只因變化時間大於往返時間就宣告沒有水錘，也忽略反射疊加及邊界條件可能仍產生瞬變。~Using mean flow velocity instead of wave speed converts a seconds-scale signal into a much longer travel time. A change slower than one round trip also does not prove the absence of transients or reflection superposition.
units.misconception: 壓力波傳播速度就是管內水的平均流速~Pressure-wave speed equals the mean velocity of water in the pipe
units.practice: 將管長加倍並將波速減少四分之一，重算往返時間，再比較一秒與十秒假想變化的尺度，僅說明分類而不推定真實操作方式。~Double length and reduce wave speed by one quarter, recalculate round-trip time and compare hypothetical one-second and ten-second changes. Describe the timescale classification without prescribing actual operating procedures.

units.anchor: 地震記錄的取樣尺度~Sampling scale for seismic records
units.title: 地震記錄的取樣尺度~Sampling scale for seismic records
units.mechanism: 地震感測器輸出若以離散時間記錄，取樣率決定可辨識的頻率上限。理想奈奎斯特條件要求取樣頻率超過最高訊號頻率兩倍，但實務還要抗混疊濾波及保留相位精度。高取樣率不能補救飽和、感測器安裝鬆動或時鐘不同步，所以監測鏈須從物理感測到資料處理一起檢查。~Discrete earthquake records can resolve only a limited frequency range set by sampling rate. The ideal Nyquist condition requires sampling above twice the highest signal frequency, while practical systems also need anti-alias filtering and adequate phase accuracy. High sampling alone cannot repair sensor saturation, loose mounting or unsynchronized clocks, so the full chain from physical sensing to data processing must be examined as one measurement system.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：fs=200 sample/s; fNyquist=fs/2=100 Hz。適用邊界：理想均勻取樣的奈奎斯特上限，實用通帶需低於此值並配濾波。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: fs=200 sample/s; fNyquist=fs/2=100 Hz. Applicable boundary: Nyquist limit for ideal uniform sampling; practical passband must lie below it with suitable filtering.
units.verify: 以已知頻率訊號做桌上資料實驗，逐步降取樣觀察假頻率，保留抗混疊濾波前後紀錄。同步檢查滿量程、安裝方向與時鐘漂移，不能只看檔案每秒筆數就判定地震資料品質。~Use a known-frequency signal in a desktop experiment, downsample progressively and observe apparent frequencies while preserving before-and-after filter records. Check full scale, mounting orientation and clock drift rather than judging earthquake data quality solely by samples per second.
units.failure: 未濾掉高頻就降取樣會把高頻折返成假低頻，可能誤認壩體出現新的振動模態；若感測器早已飽和，即使取樣率很高也無法重建被削平的真實峰值。~Downsampling without removing high frequencies aliases them into false lower frequencies that may resemble a new vibration mode. A saturated sensor likewise cannot recover clipped peaks merely because the recording rate is high.
units.misconception: 只要取樣率高就可以恢復感測器已飽和的峰值~A high sampling rate can recover peaks already clipped by sensor saturation
units.practice: 產生一個七十赫茲正弦波，分別以二百與一百赫茲取樣並比較表觀頻率，說明抗混疊濾波需在何時介入，以及這個實驗不代表實際壩體頻率。~Generate a seventy-hertz sinusoid, sample at two hundred and one hundred hertz and compare apparent frequencies. Explain when anti-alias filtering must intervene and why this experiment does not identify a real dam vibration frequency.

units.anchor: 停機發電量與留存水量~Outage energy and retained water
units.title: 停機發電量與留存水量~Outage energy and retained water
units.mechanism: 機組停機少發的電能可以用原可用功率乘時段估算，但水不會因此消失，可能留在水庫、改道或後續使用。德基梯級背景的停機帳應同時追蹤水量，避免把短期延後發電誤稱永久損失。若水位因留存上升，後續淨水頭也可能變動，使固定功率估計只是一階比較。~Energy not generated during an outage can be estimated from otherwise available power times duration, but the water remains in storage, is bypassed or is used later. A cascade outage account must therefore follow water as well as electricity, distinguishing delayed generation from permanent loss. Retained water may change level and subsequent net head, making constant-power multiplication only a first-order comparison.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh。適用邊界：固定假想可用功率，僅計停機時段少發電量，不宣稱全部永遠損失。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh. Applicable boundary: Constant hypothetical available power; energy absent during the outage only, not necessarily permanently lost.
units.verify: 把停機前預期功率曲線與實際電表逐時比較，再用同一時段水量帳辨認水是否留下或旁通。對後續補發只計實際新增能量，避免把原本就會發出的基線電量重複列為恢復。~Compare expected and metered hourly power, then use the matching water balance to identify storage or bypass. Count only genuinely additional later generation as recovery, avoiding credit for baseline energy that would have been produced anyway.
units.failure: 將少發電量全部當永久損失會忽略留水後補發；反之宣稱所有水都可補發又可能忽略溢流、時間限制與下游需求，兩種極端都沒有完成跨時段水能守恆。~Calling all missing generation permanent loss ignores later use of retained water. Claiming complete recovery can instead ignore spill, timing constraints and downstream demand; both extremes fail to close the multi-period water-energy account.
units.misconception: 停機時段少發的電能必然全部永久損失~All generation absent during an outage is necessarily lost permanently
units.practice: 假設一半留水能於後續以相同淨水頭利用，求可補回能量，再改變後續效率做敏感度分析，清楚區分延後電量、旁通損失與未知部分。~Assume half the retained water is later used at the same net head, calculate recoverable energy and vary subsequent efficiency. Distinguish deferred generation, bypass loss and unresolved quantities in the final account.
